title: [ty] Update Salsa to 0.28.5
body:
## Summary

Upgrade Salsa to 0.28.5, including the fuzz workspace. Adapt name lookups and memory reporting to the updated APIs.

## Test Plan

Workspace tests (excluding file-watching tests), Clippy, fuzz-target compilation, and file hooks passed.
